svg.title: Bytecode Analysis Engine — push API design
svg.desc: Structural diagram showing how the ProxyCodebaseSPI pushes staged JAR bytes to the BytecodeAnalysisEngine via a new analyzeJar(AnalysisRequest) method, replacing the old pull model where the engine called url.openStream() itself. A SELinux process boundary separates the caller from the isolated analysis process. The AnalysisRequest carries a content hash and local staged path. The engine returns a structured JarAnalysisReport containing per-class ClassAnalysisResult records, each with a ClinitVerdict and AtomicSerialVerdict. The signed JarAnalysisReport is then submitted to the VerdictRegistry.
svg.text: analysis engine: no outbound network · read staging dir · write result channel only
